notes:
Radiant Industries, Inc. (SEC CIK 1914078), Kaleidos 1 MWe microreactor, El Segundo CA. Census slug radiant-nuclear. POLICY P2: radiantnuclear.com is ToS-forbidden. Wayback copies were tried (web.archive.org/web/2/ for series-d-announcement and series-b returned 404; series-c-close, /news and the availability API refused connections or returned 429), so NO radiantnuclear.com evidence is cited. Pre-policy probe snapshots of radiantnuclear.com (072c5b0f991a, 5d85cdd2e8a9, 62dbbd3d7344) are deliberately not used. Every amount rests on independent sources (SEC Form D, Orrick, SiliconANGLE, DCVC, USV, USAspending). WebSearch budget was exhausted and Exa was rate limited, so discovery was limited to URLs already known. GAPS: seed rounds (2020-2021, aggregator-only figures of $1.2M and $6M, not recorded); Series B and the Series C extension have no company/investor release in evidence (company page forbidden); Series D participants beyond the two leads are unnamed ("current investors"); DOE HALEU allocation and NRIC DOME support are not evidenced here (no fetched primary page) and carry no amounts; the DOE Reactor Pilot Program states no federal money. CONFLICTS: (1) Series A: USV says USV Climate Fund led a "$10mm round"; Form D total sold is $12.62M (aggregator says $13M); ledger uses the Form D figure. (2) Series C: DCVC says $100M; Form D (2024-11-15) $100.0M; the aggregator startupintros shows $170M, which appears to combine the Nov 2024 round with the 2025 Form D tranche ($66.0M, signed 2025-06-10). (3) Series D: Orrick/SiliconANGLE say "more than $300 million"; the Form D filed 2025-12-29 shows $268.8M sold of $350.0M offered (first sale 2025-12-15), probably a partial-close snapshot. Ledger records ">$300M" and does not add the Form D total. The 2025-06-10 event (radiant-series-c-extension-2025) is an SEC Form D (first sale 2025-02-13) with no round label in the filing and no investor names; it is likely the Series C close/extension but that is unverified (company page forbidden). Participant lists for Series B and Series C come from startupintros.com (aggregator, basis reported, single source, may be incomplete or imperfect); review before publishing. Decisive Point-Radiant Industries I/II SPVs (CIK 2030456, 2126203; II sold $7.85M, filed 2026-06-24) are investor vehicles, not Radiant rounds, and are not recorded as events. Form D amounts are totals sold, not necessarily new in a single announced round. Form D signature date is used as announced_on where no release was fetched.
 VERIFIER (2026-10-05): removed 12 participants that rested only on the startupintros.com aggregator (Series B: Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, Alumni Ventures, Lux Capital, Initialized Capital; Series C: Chevron Technology Ventures, Andreessen Horowitz, Founders Fund, Union Square Ventures, Draper Associates, Boost VC, Decisive Point). The aggregator Series C page merges the Nov 2024 round with the 2025 tranche ($170M) and appears to mix in later (Series D era) investors, so it cannot place an investor in a round; these names are leads for a future pass with a primary or investor source. Series C amount now also carries the Form D (signed 2024-11-15, $99,999,999 sold, first sale 2024-10-23). The $66.0M 2025 Form D (first sale 2025-02-13) is consistent with a Series C second close (SiliconANGLE: Series D came "six months after its Series C") and is a separate offering, not a duplicate of the $100M.
